body:
🤖 Actual parent #33 linkage, exact issue body, open state and `agent-generated` label are verified. [Source/offline checkpoint](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/8ab1bb66/experiments/51-held-retention/protocol.md) starts from live main `2a1950d2` on `codex/research/51-held-retention`.

Next is inspection/reuse of #49’s source-bound retention actor and draft #50’s existing lifecycle before writing a general actor. All original #47/#49 jobs/resources are terminal/cleaned; preserve the original held journal and unaccepted scores. Initial work adds no models, native jobs, capacity or admission. Scope is a generic automatic supported failure outcome, with negative controls and inert recovery, not task repair or a new allowance. Full epic/native scientific acceptance remains unproved; keep open for review.
